name: Moving Head Test
author: Neil Heuer (heffneil)
description: Import xLights DMX moving-head models and drive one fixture live from the browser to verify it is addressed correctly and that every channel does what the model claims. A radar pad aims pan and tilt, the model's own color wheel becomes swatches, dimmer and shutter get real controls, and anything the model does not describe gets a labelled raw slider. Values are written through FPP's overlay range API, so no sequence or configuration change is needed and nothing is left behind once you release the fixture.
